headline: Steady traction in hospitals; Healthco profitability may peak out

highlights: Hospital business grew 23% YoY, led by 19% growth in established hospitals.
An INR 348mn EBITDA loss at its new hospitals dragged overall hospital margins by 60bps YoY to 24%, while EBITDA margins of established hospitals stood at 25.8%.
Online pharmacy, 24/7, turned cash EBITDA-positive; the focus ahead is on boosting order inflow, efficiencies and cost discipline.
Keimed) to touch ~6% by Q4FY27 (earlier guidance of 6.5– 7%).
valuation: The stock currently trades at an EV/EBITDA of 27.4x FY27E and 23.1x FY28E.

We value the hospital business at 25x FY28E EV/EBITDA, offline pharmacy at 21x FY28E EV/EBITDA, online pharmacy at 2x FY28E EV/sales, Keimed at 15x FY28E EV/EBITDA and AHLL at 12x FY28E EV/EBITDA (maintained for all segments).
Upside risks: Faster turnaround in profitability of 24/7; and higher-than-anticipated improvement in occupancy of hospitals.
watch: Downside risks: Higher competition in pharmacy business; and slower occupancy ramp-up at new hospitals.
